settings.name: all
settings.label: Show All Jolt Sections
settings.description: Shows or hides this section without changing any saved physics values.

settings.name: realismCustom_bulletJolts_head
settings.label: Show Head Jolts
settings.description: Shows head hit-jolt controls.

settings.name: headEnabled
settings.label: Enable Head Jolts
settings.description: Turns head hit jolts on or off for falling or on-ground ragdolls.

settings.name: headForwardStrength
settings.label: Head Forward Strength
settings.description: Forward push for head jolts.

settings.name: headUpStrength
settings.label: Head Up Strength
settings.description: Upward lift for head jolts.

settings.name: headDownStrength
settings.label: Head Down Strength
settings.description: Downward pull for head jolts.

settings.name: headRadius
settings.label: Head Radius
settings.description: Impulse radius for head jolts.

settings.name: headApplyOffset
settings.label: Head Apply Offset
settings.description: Moves the head impulse apply point inward toward the neck/chest. Higher = less whole-body lever.

settings.name: headHitDelaySec
settings.label: Head After Death Delay Before Call Can Be Made
settings.description: After the NPC dies, block head jolt calls until this timer expires. Once it expires, the next qualifying hit can jolt immediately.

settings.name: realismCustom_bulletJolts_ground
settings.label: Show Ground and Airborne Jolt Controls
settings.description: Shows regular-hit, ground-wait, airborne, strength, radius, and delay controls.

settings.name: realism_bulletJoltsEnabled
settings.label: Enable Bullet Jolts
settings.description: Use the body-part Hit Jolts system for regular bullet hits.

settings.name: realism_bulletJoltStrengthScale
settings.label: Bullet Jolt Strength Scale
settings.description: Scales the body-part jolt strengths.

settings.name: realism_bulletJoltRadiusScale
settings.label: Bullet Jolt Radius Scale
settings.description: Scales body-part jolt radii.

settings.name: realism_bulletJoltDelayScale
settings.label: Bullet Jolt Delay Scale
settings.description: Scales the regular-hit jolt delay.

settings.name: realism_bulletJoltWaitForGround
settings.label: Wait for Ground
settings.description: Waits for ground contact before applying the jolt.

settings.name: realism_bulletJoltGroundWaitMax
settings.label: Maximum Ground Wait
settings.description: Maximum time to wait for ground contact.

settings.name: realism_bulletJoltAllowAirborne
settings.label: Allow Airborne Jolts
settings.description: Allows regular-hit jolts while the body is airborne.

settings.name: realismCustom_bulletJolts_filters
settings.label: Show Jolt Enemy Filters
settings.description: Shows special-enemy jolt allow and force-scale controls.

settings.name: enemyJoltAllowMaxTac
settings.label: Bullet Jolts can affect MaxTac
settings.description: ON = Bullet Jolts can affect MaxTac / 2nd-wave ship-drop police. OFF = excluded from Bullet Jolts.

settings.name: enemyJoltScaleMaxTac
settings.label: MaxTac Bullet Jolt scale
settings.description: Multiplier for Bullet Jolts on MaxTac/drop-ship police. 1.0 = same as normal NPCs.

settings.name: enemyJoltScaleBosses
settings.label: Boss Bullet Jolt scale
settings.description: Boss Bullet Jolt multiplier. Lower this if bosses should feel heavier.

settings.name: enemyJoltScaleMechs
settings.label: Mech Bullet Jolt scale
settings.description: Mech Bullet Jolt multiplier. Default is lower so machines feel heavier.

settings.name: enemyJoltScaleRobots
settings.label: Robot/drone Bullet Jolt scale
settings.description: Robot/drone Bullet Jolt multiplier. Default is lower so machines feel heavier.
